digest.component_or_area: Plan clarity and deterministic P1 readiness
propositions: Current length-and-heading heuristic fails to reject empty parsed Acceptance Criteria items and unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections
Empty joined checkbox bodies in Acceptance Criteria sections must fail standalone clarity and plan-review P1 deterministic floor

Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail deterministic P1 when appearing as value assignments, unless suppressed by same-line removal or negation terms
Sentinel detection must ignore fenced code blocks and inline backtick code, and fire only when starting a line, following punctuation or assignment operators, or following specific trigger words
A shared pure parser must be added to enforce these rules uniformly across both standalone clarity and plan-review deterministic surfaces without changing ticket-type exemptions
